Your list is Empty!

entries.zh:
列表为空！
点击加号添加条目。

entries.key: Template pass names separated by semicolon (;). Empty means it will be included in all passes.
entries.zh: 用分号（;）分隔模板通道名称。留空表示应用于所有通道。

entries.key: Valid SRP version numbers must have 6 digits and be equal or higher than 100000, the lowest supported version.
entries.zh: 有效 SRP 版本号必须为六位数字，且不小于最低支持版本 100000。

entries.key:
Activates the use of tessellation which subdivides polygons to increase geometry detail using a set of rules
Default: OFF
entries.zh:
启用曲面细分，按照指定规则细分多边形以增加几何细节。
默认：关闭

entries.key: An 8 bit mask as an 0-255 integer, used when comparing the reference value with the contents of the buffer (referenceValue & readMask) comparisonFunction (stencilBufferValue & readMask)
entries.zh: 用于比较参考值与缓冲内容的 8 位读取掩码（0–255）：先分别与读取掩码进行按位与运算，再执行比较。

entries.key: An 8 bit mask as an 0-255 integer, used when writing to the buffer
entries.zh: 写入模板缓冲时使用的 8 位掩码，取值为 0–255。

entries.key:
Applies a dither crossfade to be used with LOD groups for smoother transitions. Uses one interpolator
Default: OFF
entries.zh:
为 LOD 组应用抖动交叉淡化，使切换更平滑。占用一个插值器。
默认：关闭

entries.key:
Base rendering queue index
(Background = 1000, Geometry = 2000, AlphaTest = 2450, Transparent = 3000, Overlay = 4000)
Default: Geometry
entries.zh:
基础渲染队列索引
背景 = 1000，几何 = 2000，透明度测试 = 2450，透明 = 3000，覆盖 = 4000。
默认：几何

entries.key:
Categorizes shaders into several predefined groups, usually to be used with screen shader effects
Default: Opaque
entries.zh:
将着色器划分为预定义类型，通常用于屏幕特效。
默认：不透明

entries.key:
Default clip value to be compared with opacity alpha ( 0 = fully Opaque, 1 = fully Masked )
Default: 0.5
entries.zh:
与不透明度比较的默认裁剪阈值（0 = 完全不透明，1 = 完全裁剪）。
默认：0.5

entries.key:
Defines how the surface blends with the background
Default: Opaque
entries.zh:
定义表面与背景的混合方式。
默认：不透明

entries.key: Disables objects to be batched and used with DrawCallBatching Default: False
entries.zh:
禁止该物体参与绘制调用合批。
默认：关闭

entries.key:
Generates a shadow caster pass for vertex modifications and point lights in forward rendering
Default: ON
entries.zh:
为顶点修改和前向渲染中的点光源生成阴影投射通道。
默认：开启

entries.key: If True always use surface default shadow caster Default: False
entries.zh:
始终使用表面着色器的默认阴影投射通道。
默认：关闭

entries.key: If True creates a material toggle to set Unity's internal reflections rendering keyword
entries.zh: 创建材质开关，用于控制 Unity 内置反射渲染关键字。

entries.key: If True creates a material toggle to set Unity's internal specular highlight rendering keyword
entries.zh: 创建材质开关，用于控制 Unity 内置镜面高光渲染关键字。

entries.key: If True forces disable instancing on shader independent of having instanced properties
entries.zh: 无论是否存在实例化属性，均强制禁用着色器实例化。

entries.key: If True forces instancing on shader independent of having instanced properties
entries.zh: 无论是否存在实例化属性，均强制启用着色器实例化。

entries.key: If True then an object that is rendered using this subshader will never cast shadows Default: False
entries.zh:
使用此子着色器的物体不投射阴影。
默认：关闭

entries.key: If True then an object that uses this shader will not be affected by Projectors Default: False
entries.zh:
使用此着色器的物体不受投影器影响。
默认：关闭

曲面细分的最大距离。
默认：25

曲面细分的最小距离。
默认：10
修改自发光的全局光照标记。

entries.key:
Modifies positions of the subdivided faces so that the resulting surface follows the mesh normals a bit
Default: OFF
entries.zh:
沿网格法线调整细分后的顶点位置，使表面更平滑。
默认：关闭

entries.key:
Polygon culling mode prevents rendering of either back-facing or front-facing polygons to save performance, turn it off if you want to render both sides
Default: Back
entries.zh:
剔除背面或正面多边形以节省性能；若要双面渲染，请关闭剔除。
默认：背面

entries.key:
Selects and generates passes for the supported rendering paths
Default: All
entries.zh:
选择并生成支持的渲染路径所需的通道。
默认：全部

entries.key:
Sets color channel writing mask, turning all off makes the object completely invisible
Default: RGBA
entries.zh:
设置颜色通道写入掩码；关闭所有通道会使物体完全不可见。
默认：RGBA

entries.key:
Surface shader lighting model defines how the surface reflects light
Default: Standard
entries.zh:
表面着色器的光照模型决定表面如何反射光线。
默认：标准

entries.key:
Templates is a feature that is still heavily under development and users may experience some problems.
Please email support@amplify.pt if any issue occurs.
entries.zh:
模板功能仍在持续开发中，可能遇到问题。
如有问题，请联系 support@amplify.pt。

曲面细分因子。
默认：4

entries.key:
Tessellation levels ccomputed based on triangle edge length on the screen
Default: 4
entries.zh:
根据屏幕上的三角形边长计算曲面细分级别。
默认：4

entries.key: The value to be compared against (if Comparison is anything else than always) and/or the value to be written to the buffer (if either Pass, Fail or ZFail is set to replace)
entries.zh: 用于模板比较的参考值（比较模式不是“始终通过”时）；当通过、失败或深度失败操作设为“替换”时，也用作写入缓冲的值。

entries.key:
Untick it to disable shadow receiving, this includes self-shadowing (only for forward rendering) 
Default: ON
entries.zh:
关闭阴影接收，包括自阴影；仅适用于前向渲染。
默认：开启

entries.key:
Use it to group or ungroup different refraction shaders into the same or different grabpass (only for forward rendering) 
Default: 0
entries.zh:
通过相同或不同的抓屏通道编号，对折射着色器进行分组；仅适用于前向渲染。
默认：0

entries.key:
Value to offset the render queue, accepts both positive values to render later and negative values to render sooner
Default: 0
entries.zh:
渲染队列偏移：正值延后渲染，负值提前渲染。
默认：0
